title: A dream world I visited a few times
content: This is the same text I used in other sub: Sometimes I have dreams about a world similar to ours, but with less light perhaps. There is the equivalent to Australia, where the light is more beautiful, altought the sun sets early (few hours of light during the day). I thnk that continents may be different, with perhaps the exception of Australia. And I think that its also in this world that there are caves, big underground caves with some light, conected to each other and where there is some sense of adventure. Anyone resonates with this? EDIT: In this new post I will also add that for some reason I considered this world some kind of "shadow" world, more empty. I also remember Australia as beeing one of the most beautiful places in that world, in part because there was more light and the sky had this blue tone, different from usual. It was a safe place, the other places in the world were in danger (dont ask me the reason, cant remember).
